text:
nova_sales: Hey team — Proteus Health asked for an RFI package. Scope: 4-week POC (private VPC peering + CloudHSM or on-prem HSM), capability matrix, pricing tiers for embeddings (target 75 QPS) and streaming, plus KMS/HSM attestation and sample SOW. They attached proteus_rfi_v1.pdf.

sam_se: I can own the capability matrix and written responses. Quick checks: do they need SAML/SCIM? Also confirm whether Dedicated Reserved is OK for 75 QPS.

elaine_infra: Reserved Dedicated (4xA10) should meet 75 QPS with batching + KV cache. On-prem HSM supported (Thales/Entrust/AWS CloudHSM). We can provide SOC2 and ISO artifacts under NDA; FedRAMP is a planning note only. We never persist plaintext customer keys; cryptographic ops are delegated to customer KMS/HSM. I'll upload a KMS flow diagram.

vikas_prod: For pricing: propose POC reserved month at 40% off list, includes 8 hours/week SE support. Production: tiered per-embed bands and per-token streaming rates; optional observability retention add-on. I'll draft SOW with milestones and acceptance criteria (embedding recall threshold + latency).

nova_sales: Legal asked for "HSM vendor attestation + KMS flow diagram" and an NDA before certs. Can infra attach cert IDs and a short attestation note we can share under NDA?

elaine_infra: Cert refs to share under NDA: SOC2-2024-RED-077, ISO-RED-1210. Uploaded placeholder attestation: proteus_hsm_attest.txt -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/2923456789/proteus_hsm_attest.txt and KMS flow png -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/2923456789/proteus_kms_flow.png

sam_se: Draft capability matrix snippet (will convert to spreadsheet):

"Requirement | Redwood response | Notes
Private VPC peering | Supported | Customer-managed peering
HSM/KMS | CloudHSM, Thales, Entrust | On-prem with lead time
Embeddings throughput | 75 QPS achievable | 4xA10, batching, KV cache
Streaming | Supported, low-latency | Token-chunked streams, SLA options
SAML/SCIM | Supported | SCIM 2.0, group->role mapping
Audit logs | Configurable retention | 30/90/365 (paid tiers)
Attestations | SOC2, ISO27001 (NDA) | FedRAMP status note
"

sam_se: I'll attach the spreadsheet and flag open items: exact egress locking requirements, SCIM attribute mapping, and SLA percentile wording.

nova_sales: Next steps: (1) @sam_se finalize capmatrix + narrative by EOD, (2) @elaine_infra attach formal attestation under NDA and KMS diagram, (3) @vikas_prod finalize pricing + SOW. Legal: send NDA template to Proteus. Target: send RFI package once NDA in place.

legal-bot: Will send NDA template and advise on marking cert artifacts "NDA only." We'll review SLA credit wording if Proteus requests it.

vikas_prod: I'll include an example acceptance test: embedding recall >= 0.7 on provided eval + 95th pct token streaming latency < 250ms. Also include optional int8 quant path.

nova_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll assemble and post when sent. End of thread.
